entities.name: Lucius Lucretius Flavus Tricipitinus
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Lucius Lucretius Tricipitinus Flavus  was a Roman statesman and general who had a prominent career in the early 4th century BC, serving once as consul, and four times as consular tribune, as well as perhaps serving as Princeps senatus.
